visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a hand wearing a white sleeve and holding a purple patterned fabric bag with a bear illustration against a grey asphalt road background. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a green plastic shopping basket containing a carton of eggs, a box of Snow Brand butter, a red package of snacks, and a tube of cooking sheets. (3) A screen recording of a smartphone displays a product page for a bear-shaped gateau chocolat baking kit with several images and Japanese text. (4) A woman with short blonde hair wearing a beige fleece sweater is seen in a kitchen unboxing the kit, holding a red-and-white instruction manual and looking at the camera. (5) A close-up shows a whisk stirring a thick, glossy dark chocolate batter in a glass bowl on a kitchen counter. (6) Hands are shown pouring the dark batter into small, bear-shaped brown paper molds neatly arranged on a black metal baking tray. (7) The woman holds up the baking tray, presenting several baked, dark brown bear-shaped cakes that have risen slightly. (8) A series of close-up shots show hands using a white chocolate decoration pen to carefully draw eyes, muzzles, and mouths on the bear cakes. (9) A grid-like arrangement of eight finished bear cakes is shown, each with unique and slightly distorted facial expressions, ranging from winking to broad smiles. (10) A man with black hair, wearing a white dress shirt, navy blue tie, and a white face mask, holds a packaged bear cake while looking down with an emotional expression. (11) The man holds two separate transparent bags containing bear cakes and small figurines, smiling at the camera in an office-like setting. (12) The final shot shows a hand holding a packaged bag of three bear cakes against a plain white wall background.
